mapper.sql: n.id, n.tenant_id as tenantId, n.notice_type as messageType, n.target_scope as targetScope, n.target_user_id as targetUserId, n.target_role_id as targetRoleId, u.username as targetUserName, role.role_name as targetRoleName, n.title, n.content, n.source_type as sourceType, n.publish_status as publishStatus, n.published_at as publishedAt, n.created_by as createdBy, n.updated_by as updatedBy, n.created_at as createdAt, n.updated_at as updatedAt, case when r.id is null then 0 else 1 end as readFlag, r.read_at as readAt

mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.username, u.email, wb.openid as wechatOpenid from sys_user u join sys_user_tenant ut on ut.user_id = u.id and ut.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ut.deleted = 0 left join sys_user_wechat_binding wb on wb.user_id = u.id and wb.deleted = 0 where u.id = #{userId} and u.deleted = 0 and u.status = 'ENABLED' limit 1
